label: EmbeddingProvider - 3 fixes: warmUp comment, DeterministicProvider maxTokens, ensureReady guard
summary: Fixed 3 issues in libs/data/embed/embedding-provider/src/: misleading warmUp comment in fastembed.ts, hardcoded maxTokens:512 in DeterministicProvider, and silent resolve in ensureReady() when worker not initialized

changes.kind: Fix 1: replaced misleading warmUp comment with accurate explanation of the no-op
Fix 3: added ResolutionError import and guard in ensureReady() — throws if neither ready nor readyPromise is set
Fix 2: added maxTokens parameter (defaults to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) to constructor, uses it in metadata instead of hardcoded 512
Fix 2: passes Infinity as maxTokens to DeterministicProvider from factory

issues: NONE — all 30 tests pass, lint clean, build clean
handoff_notes: DeterministicProvider constructor now accepts 3rd param maxTokens (default Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) — callers passing positional args after dimensions are unaffected.
FastembedProvider.ensureReady() now throws ResolutionError if neither ready nor readyPromise is set — previously it resolved silently.
ResolutionError is now imported by fastembed.ts from index.js.
